request.subject: PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:GUARD

layers.text: Zoom in to a close-up portrait: redraw it as only the head and the top of the shoulders, twice as big, filling the image. A huge round bald head with bright leaf green skin, colour #5aa546, with a lighter #98d975 face and jaw, a heavy bare jaw with no beard, two cream tusks, small grumpy eyes, an orange nose, a small round light grey tin cap on top of the head with no nose guard. Keep the thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
